description: Search the SNMP definitions knowledge base for existing profiles and device templates. ALWAYS call this before authoring a new SNMP profile, to retrieve real OID->field examples for the target vendor and to reuse verified OIDs. Returns name, vendor, description, field_names, oid_count, matching_rules, member profiles, and the full raw_json of the closest existing definitions. Pass vendor='Any' to include generic standard-MIB profiles (recommended in every call).

configuration.query: FROM snmp-definitions-kb METADATA _score | WHERE (?vendor == "Any" OR vendor == ?vendor OR vendor == "Any") AND (match(semantic, ?query) OR match(field_names, ?query) OR match(description, ?query)) | SORT _score DESC | KEEP kind, name, vendor, product, description, field_names, oid_count, matching_rules, profiles, raw_json | LIMIT 8

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'Cisco CPU and memory', 'interface counters', 'temperature and fan sensors'.

vendor.description: Vendor to filter on, e.g. 'Cisco', 'Arista', 'Dell'. Use 'Any' to retrieve all (including generic standard-MIB profiles). Always provide a value.
